en.headline: Paul Chan says five-year plan gives firms longer-term investment certainty
en.dek: The financial secretary wrote that the blueprint's targets and timelines help businesses align decisions with government goals amid a volatile external environment.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po said Hong Kong's first five-year plan will give businesses greater certainty to make long-term investment decisions, especially when the external environment remains volatile.

In his weekly blog published on Sunday, Chan said the plan's targets and timelines allow companies to see the city's direction over the next five years and better align their own plans with the government's.

"The significance of planning lies not only in the document itself, but also in looking at today from the perspective of the future and turning a vision into indicators and action plans that can be reviewed year by year," he wrote.

Chan added that the more volatile the external environment becomes, the more the market needs certainty that extends beyond a single year. The five-year plan was unveiled earlier this week alongside the Policy Address.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：五年規劃為企業提供更長遠投資確定性
zh.dek: 財政司司長在周日網誌指，規劃的目標及時間表有助企業在外部環境波動下，與政府方向對齊投資決定。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，香港首個五年規劃將為企業提供更大確定性，以便作出長遠投資決定，尤其在外部環境持續波動之際。
他在周日發表的每周網誌中指出，規劃的目標及時間表讓企業看到未來五年的發展方向，並能更好地將自身計劃與政府目標對齊。
陳茂波寫道：「規劃的意義不僅在於文件本身，更在於從未來的視角審視今天，把願景轉化為可逐年檢視的指標及行動計劃。」
他補充，外部環境越波動，市場越需要超越單一年度的確定性。五年規劃本周早前與施政報告一併公布。
